textbook.title: Standard Ten Mathematics
textbook.publisher: Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation

units.title: Relations and Functions
units.theme: Ordered Pairs, Cartesian Products, Relations & Function Mappings

lessons.title: Cartesian Products & Relations
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.1: Cartesian Products & Ordered Pairs
checklist_items.description: Find A x B, A x A, B x A, non-empty subsets, and verify distributive properties of Cartesian product (Questions 1 to 7).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.2: Relations & Representations
checklist_items.description: Determine whether given relations are subsets of A x B; arrow diagrams, roster form, domain and range (Questions 1 to 5).

lessons.title: Functions & Types of Functions
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.3: Functions, Domain & Mapping
checklist_items.description: Identify functions, evaluate function values f(x), determine domain and range from algebraic and word formulations (Questions 1 to 10).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.4: Types of Functions & Vertical Line Test
checklist_items.description: Classify one-one, onto, bijection, identity, constant functions; use vertical & horizontal line tests (Questions 1 to 12).

lessons.title: Composition of Functions & Graphs
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.5: Composition of Functions (f o g & g o f)
checklist_items.description: Calculate composite functions f o g and g o f, verify associativity f o (g o h) = (f o g) o h, solve for unknowns (Questions 1 to 10).

lessons.title: Unit 1 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 1.6: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: Practice 15 board exam-style objective questions covering relations and functions (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 1: Comprehensive Review Problems
checklist_items.description: High-order thinking skills and comprehensive revision problems for Unit 1 (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember & Definitions Summary
checklist_items.description: Review key definitions: Cartesian product, relation, function, types of mappings, and composition properties.

units.title: Numbers and Sequences
units.theme: Euclid's Lemma, Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, AP, GP & Special Series

lessons.title: Euclid's Division & Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.1: Euclid's Division Lemma & Algorithm
checklist_items.description: Apply a = bq + r (0 <= r < b) to find HCF and prove properties of positive integers (Questions 1 to 10).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.2: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
checklist_items.description: Prime factorizations, finding LCM and HCF, and resolving exponential divisibility questions (Questions 1 to 9).

lessons.title: Modular Arithmetic & Sequences
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.3: Modular Arithmetic & Congruence Modulo
checklist_items.description: Solve congruences a ≡ b (mod n), find least positive values of x, and solve time/clock arithmetic (Questions 1 to 9).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.4: Sequences & nth Terms
checklist_items.description: Generate terms of sequences, find nth term from recurrence relations and piecewise rules (Questions 1 to 6).

lessons.title: Arithmetic Progression & Series (AP)
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.5: Arithmetic Progression (nth term tn = a + (n-1)d)
checklist_items.description: Determine whether sequences are in AP, find first term, common difference, general term tn, and consecutive terms (Questions 1 to 14).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.6: Sum of n terms of an AP (Sn)
checklist_items.description: Calculate sum of AP using Sn = n/2(2a + (n-1)d) and Sn = n/2(a + l); solve real-life applied problems (Questions 1 to 12).

lessons.title: Geometric Progression & Special Series
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.7: Geometric Progression (tn = a*r^(n-1))
checklist_items.description: Identify GP, common ratio r, find general term, solve for terms in continued proportion (Questions 1 to 12).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.8: Sum to n terms of a GP (Sn)
checklist_items.description: Calculate sum of finite and infinite GP series using Sn = a(r^n - 1)/(r - 1) and S∞ = a/(1 - r) (Questions 1 to 10).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.9: Special Series (Sum of n, n², n³)
checklist_items.description: Compute sums of first n natural numbers, odd numbers, squares ∑k², and cubes ∑k³ (Questions 1 to 7).

lessons.title: Unit 2 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 2.10: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 15 objective questions on Euclid's lemma, modular arithmetic, AP, GP, and series (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 2: Comprehensive Review Problems
checklist_items.description: Challenging review questions on numbers, progressions, and series (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Progression Formulas
checklist_items.description: Memorize and review key formulas for AP (tn, Sn), GP (tn, Sn, S∞), and special summation identities.

units.title: Algebra
units.theme: Linear Systems, GCD/LCM, Rational Expressions, Quadratic Equations, Variations & Matrices

lessons.title: Linear Systems, GCD & LCM of Polynomials
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.1: Simultaneous Linear Equations in Three Variables
checklist_items.description: Solve systems of linear equations in three variables using elimination and classify nature of solutions (Questions 1 to 3).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.2: GCD of Polynomials by Long Division
checklist_items.description: Find Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of polynomials using long division algorithm (Questions 1 to 2).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.3: LCM and Relationship between LCM & GCD
checklist_items.description: Find LCM of polynomials and verify f(x) * g(x) = LCM * GCD (Questions 1 to 4).

lessons.title: Rational Expressions & Square Root of Polynomials
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.4: Reduction & Excluded Values of Rational Expressions
checklist_items.description: Reduce rational expressions to lowest terms and find excluded values where denominator is zero (Questions 1 to 2).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.5: Multiplication & Division of Rational Expressions
checklist_items.description: Perform multiplication and division on rational algebraic fractions (Questions 1 to 5).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.6: Addition & Subtraction of Rational Expressions
checklist_items.description: Add and subtract rational expressions with like and unlike denominators (Questions 1 to 8).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.7: Square Root of Polynomials by Factorization
checklist_items.description: Find square root of expressions and trinomials using factorization identities (Questions 1 to 2).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.8: Square Root by Division Method (5-Mark Essential)
checklist_items.description: Find square root of 4th degree polynomials using division algorithm and determine unknown coefficients (Questions 1 to 3).

lessons.title: Quadratic Equations: Methods, Roots & Applied Problems
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.9: Formation of Quadratic Equations
checklist_items.description: Form quadratic equations given sum and product of roots x² - (Sum)x + Product = 0 (Questions 1 to 2).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.10: Solving Quadratic Equations by Factorization
checklist_items.description: Solve quadratic equations by factoring into linear binomials (Questions 1 to 2).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.11: Completing the Square & Quadratic Formula
checklist_items.description: Solve using method of completing the square and quadratic formula x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / (2a) (Questions 1 to 3).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.12: Applied Word Problems on Quadratic Equations
checklist_items.description: Solve real-life word problems involving numbers, speed-distance-time, geometry, and age (Questions 1 to 9).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.13: Nature of Roots (Discriminant Δ = b² - 4ac)
checklist_items.description: Classify roots as real and unequal, real and equal, or no real roots; solve for unknown parameters (Questions 1 to 5).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.14: Relation between Roots and Coefficients
checklist_items.description: Evaluate symmetric expressions in α and β (α² + β², α/β + β/α) and construct new quadratic equations (Questions 1 to 6).

lessons.title: Practical Graphs (8-Mark Board Exam Section)
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.15: Graph of Variations (Direct & Inverse Variation)
checklist_items.description: Draw graphs of direct variation (y = kx) and inverse variation (xy = k), find constant of variation and interpolate values (Questions 1 to 6).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.16: Quadratic Graphs & Intersections (Parabolas)
checklist_items.description: Draw graphs of parabolas y = ax² + bx + c and determine roots graphically by solving simultaneously with straight lines (Questions 1 to 8).

lessons.title: Matrices: Order, Operations & Multiplication
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.17: Matrix Types, Order & Transpose
checklist_items.description: Identify order of matrices, construct matrices from general rules aij, and compute matrix transposes (Questions 1 to 7).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.18: Matrix Addition, Subtraction & Scalar Operations
checklist_items.description: Perform addition and subtraction of conformable matrices, solve matrix equations for X (Questions 1 to 8).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.19: Matrix Multiplication & Properties
checklist_items.description: Verify matrix multiplication compatibility, associative property A(BC) = (AB)C, distributive property, and (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ (Questions 1 to 13).

lessons.title: Unit 3 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 3.20: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 20 high-yield board exam multiple choice questions covering the entire algebra syllabus (Questions 1 to 20).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 3: Comprehensive Review Problems
checklist_items.description: Advanced problem-solving across linear systems, rational expressions, quadratic equations, and matrices (Questions 1 to 20).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Algebra Formulas & Theorems
checklist_items.description: Consolidated summary of quadratic formulas, discriminant conditions, variation rules, and matrix properties.

units.title: Geometry
units.theme: Similarity, Thales Theorem, Pythagoras Theorem, Circles, Tangents & Concurrency

lessons.title: Similarity, Thales Theorem & Angle Bisector Theorem
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 4.1: Similarity of Triangles & Criteria
checklist_items.description: Establish similarity using AAA, SAS, SSS criteria; ratio of areas of similar triangles (Questions 1 to 13).

checklist_items.label: Theorem 1 & 3 Proofs: Thales (BPT) & Angle Bisector Theorems
checklist_items.description: Master statement and formal proofs for Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT) and Angle Bisector Theorem.

checklist_items.label: Exercise 4.2: Applications of Thales & Angle Bisector Theorems
checklist_items.description: Apply Thales theorem, converse of Thales theorem, and Angle Bisector theorem to compute unknown lengths (Questions 1 to 14).

lessons.title: Pythagoras Theorem, Circles & Tangents
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Theorem 5 Proof: Pythagoras Theorem (Baudhayana Theorem)
checklist_items.description: Learn and memorize the formal proof of Pythagoras Theorem and its converse.

checklist_items.label: Exercise 4.3: Applications of Pythagoras Theorem
checklist_items.description: Solve geometrical right-triangle problems, ladders, distances, and prove geometric relations (Questions 1 to 8).

checklist_items.label: Theorem 6, Ceva & Menelaus: Tangent & Concurrency Theorems
checklist_items.description: Master Alternate Segment Theorem, chord-tangent power theorems, and concurrency conditions (Ceva & Menelaus).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 4.4: Circles, Tangents & Alternate Segment Theorem
checklist_items.description: Calculate tangent lengths, angles in alternate segment, chord intersections, and concurrency (Questions 1 to 16).

lessons.title: Unit 4 Review & Practical Geometry Check
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 4.5: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 16 objective geometry questions on similarity, circles, tangents, and theorems (Questions 1 to 16).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 4: Comprehensive Geometry Problems
checklist_items.description: Challenging geometric proofs and computations (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Geometric Theorems Summary
checklist_items.description: Review statements of BPT, Angle Bisector, Pythagoras, Alternate Segment, Ceva, and Menelaus theorems.

units.title: Coordinate Geometry
units.theme: Area of Figures, Slope of Lines & Straight Line Equations

lessons.title: Area of Triangle & Quadrilateral
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 5.1: Area of Triangle, Quadrilateral & Collinearity
checklist_items.description: Calculate area of triangle 1/2[(x1(y2-y3)+...], prove collinearity of three points, and find quadrilateral area (Questions 1 to 11).

lessons.title: Slope, Inclination & Straight Line Equations
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 5.2: Slope (m = tan θ = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1)), Parallel & Perpendicular Lines
checklist_items.description: Compute slope of lines, use condition for parallel lines (m1 = m2) and perpendicular lines (m1 * m2 = -1) (Questions 1 to 13).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 5.3: Straight Line Equations (Forms: Slope-Intercept, Point-Slope, Two-Point, Intercept)
checklist_items.description: Derive line equations using y = mx + c, y - y1 = m(x - x1), (y - y1)/(y2 - y1) = (x - x1)/(x2 - x1), x/a + y/b = 1 (Questions 1 to 14).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 5.4: General Form of Straight Line (ax + by + c = 0)
checklist_items.description: Find slope -a/b, y-intercept -c/b, equation of lines parallel (ax+by+k=0) and perpendicular (bx-ay+k=0), and intersection points (Questions 1 to 12).

lessons.title: Unit 5 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 5.5: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 15 board exam multiple choice questions on area, slopes, and straight line forms (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 5: Coordinate Geometry Problems
checklist_items.description: Comprehensive review questions on triangles, quadrilaterals, medians, altitudes, and straight lines (Questions 1 to 10).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Coordinate Geometry Formulas
checklist_items.description: Quick reference for area formulas, slope formulas, line equation forms, and concurrency relations.

lessons.title: Trigonometric Identities
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 6.1: Proving Trigonometric Identities
checklist_items.description: Prove trigonometric identities using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ (Questions 1 to 10).

lessons.title: Heights and Distances (Elevation & Depression)
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 6.2: Angle of Elevation Applications
checklist_items.description: Solve heights and distances problems involving towers, trees, buildings, and kites with angle of elevation (Questions 1 to 6).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 6.3: Angle of Depression Applications
checklist_items.description: Calculate heights, depths, and distances using line of sight and angle of depression (Questions 1 to 6).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 6.4: Combined Elevation & Depression Problems
checklist_items.description: Solve complex real-life scenarios with both elevation and depression from different observation points (Questions 1 to 5).

lessons.title: Unit 6 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 6.5: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 14 objective questions on trigonometric identities, angles, and heights and distances (Questions 1 to 14).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 6: Trigonometric Review Problems
checklist_items.description: Challenging identity proofs and multi-step height and distance problems (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Trigonometry Values & Identities
checklist_items.description: Memorize trigonometric ratios of standard angles (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) and fundamental identities.

units.title: Mensuration
units.theme: Surface Area & Volume of Solids, Combined Solids & Conversion of Shapes

lessons.title: Surface Area of Solids & Frustum
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 7.1: CSA & TSA of Cylinder, Hollow Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Hemisphere & Frustum
checklist_items.description: Calculate Curved Surface Area (CSA) and Total Surface Area (TSA) of standard 3D solids and frustums (Questions 1 to 10).

lessons.title: Volume of Solids, Combined Solids & Conversion
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 7.2: Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Hemisphere & Frustum
checklist_items.description: Compute volume of cylinders, hollow cylinders, cones, spheres, hemispheres, and frustums (Questions 1 to 10).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 7.3: Volume & Surface Area of Combined Solids
checklist_items.description: Solve problems of composite shapes: cylinder surmounted by cone/hemisphere, capsule, tent (Questions 1 to 7).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 7.4: Conversion of Solids from One Shape to Another
checklist_items.description: Calculate dimensions, number of objects formed when melting and recasting solids with unchanged volume (Questions 1 to 8).

lessons.title: Unit 7 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 7.5: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 15 objective questions on surface areas, volumes, combined solids, and conversion (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 7: Mensuration Word Problems
checklist_items.description: Applied word problems on cost of painting, water rate flowing through pipes, and melting solids (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Mensuration Formulas Table
checklist_items.description: Memorize complete table of CSA, TSA, and Volume formulas for cylinder, cone, sphere, hemisphere, and frustum.

units.title: Statistics and Probability
units.theme: Measures of Dispersion, Coefficient of Variation & Probability Theorems

lessons.title: Measures of Dispersion & Coefficient of Variation
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 8.1: Range, Standard Deviation (σ) & Variance
checklist_items.description: Calculate range L - S, coefficient of range, standard deviation σ by direct, assumed mean, step deviation methods (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 8.2: Coefficient of Variation (C.V. = σ/x̄ * 100%)
checklist_items.description: Compute Coefficient of Variation (C.V.) to compare consistency and stability between data sets (Questions 1 to 8).

lessons.title: Probability & Addition Theorem
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 8.3: Basic Probability, Sample Space & Events
checklist_items.description: Calculate probabilities for tossing coins, rolling dice, pack of cards, and calendar leap year questions (Questions 1 to 13).

checklist_items.label: Exercise 8.4: Addition Theorem of Probability
checklist_items.description: Apply P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B) and P(A ∪ B ∪ C); mutually exclusive and independent events (Questions 1 to 13).

lessons.title: Unit 8 Review & Assessment
lessons.author: Department of School Education, Tamil Nadu

checklist_items.label: Exercise 8.5: Multiple Choice Questions
checklist_items.description: 15 objective questions on standard deviation, variance, coefficient of variation, and probability (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Unit Exercise - 8: Statistics & Probability Problems
checklist_items.description: Comprehensive problems on variance of altered data, combining groups, and multi-event probabilities (Questions 1 to 15).

checklist_items.label: Points to Remember: Statistics & Probability Laws
checklist_items.description: Summary of formulas for standard deviation, variance, C.V., and Addition Theorems of Probability.
